response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack engineer (14+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js depth, current experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks, exposure to multiple languages (Java, C#, DLang, PHP), cloud/containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and relational/NoSQL databases. He lacks explicit Nest.js and Vitest experience and shows no React presence in his most recent role, but his broad polyglot background and rapid learning curve make him a strong candidate worth interviewing.
strengths: 14+ years of full-stack engineering across web, mobile, and backend systems
Current hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, directly relevant to the role
Strong polyglot background (TypeScript, Java, C#, DLang) plus Docker/Kubernetes and CI/CD experience
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js, Vitest, or Playwright experience
Recent roles show less emphasis on React/frontend work compared to backend
Career shows frequent job changes and diverse side-projects, which may indicate limited long-term focus on one stack

key_factors.factor: Deep TypeScript/Node.js and polyglot backend expertise
